svg.title: Сгибание с акцентом на брахиалис — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Illustrate a standing single-arm CROSS-BODY HAMMER CURL as the brachialis-emphasis variant. One dumbbell in active right hand. Front three-quarter view. LEFT right hand by right thigh, neutral grip, elbow beside trunk. RIGHT elbow still beside trunk, right forearm flexes diagonally toward left chest, thumb leads the movement and palm faces torso, never twists palm up. Free left arm relaxed. No bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
